entity: Messrs. R. C. Barkley and R. C. Moores, II, District Geologists, Continental Oil Company
stance_basis: paraphrase states little provision made for productive use of vehicles in mineral exploration and mining
summary: Messrs. R. C. Barkley and R. C. Moores, II, District Geologists at Continental Oil Company, submitted separate individual comments (log entries #46 and #47) objecting that the draft ORV environmental statement made little provision for the productive use of vehicles in mineral exploration and mining. Their concern was grouped with numerous other mining-industry commenters who sought exemptions or special accommodations for mining vehicles under the proposed ORV regulations.
complaint_summary: Barkley and Moores stated that little provision had been made for productive use of vehicles in exploration and development of mineral exploration and mining.
